items.name: AI Google Review Follow-up System
items.whatItDoes: Automatically follows up with customers after a job or purchase, asking happy customers to leave a review at the right moment — and routing unhappy ones to you privately first.
items.whyValuable: Most satisfied customers never leave a review simply because nobody asked at the right time. This closes that gap without you having to chase anyone manually.
benefits: More reviews from customers who were already happy
Negative feedback caught before it goes public

items.name: AI Website Chatbot
items.whatItDoes: A chatbot trained on your services, pricing structure, and common questions, live on your website around the clock.
items.whyValuable: Enquiries that come in outside office hours are usually lost. This answers the common questions immediately and hands qualified leads straight to you.
benefits: Fewer repetitive questions in your inbox

items.name: Google Ads Management
items.whatItDoes: Campaign strategy, setup, and ongoing management of your Google Ads account, aimed at enquiries rather than clicks.
items.whyValuable: Ad spend managed properly can be one of the fastest ways to generate new enquiries — badly managed, it's one of the fastest ways to lose money.
items.price: Custom quote, based on ad spend and goals
benefits: Campaigns targeted at people ready to buy
Full visibility into where your budget goes
Ongoing optimisation, not a set-and-forget campaign

items.name: Website Design
items.whatItDoes: A custom-built, mobile-first website designed around what your customers need to see to actually get in touch.
items.whyValuable: A site that looks fine but doesn't convert is costing you enquiries every day it's live.
items.price: Custom quote, based on project scope
benefits: Built around your business, not a template
Fast, mobile-first, and easy to update yourself
A foundation that makes every other service work harder

benefits: A professional, consistent look across every touchpoint
Assets you own and can hand to anyone
A brand that matches the quality of your actual work
